senses.gloss: to be hidden, sunk, to be mixed up beyond recognition.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:11">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>וכולן נִטְמְעוּ בכהונה</he> and all of them have been lost among the priesthood (can no longer be distinguished from original priests).
Ib. 71ᵃ a family שנִיטְמְעָה נ׳ (or שנִיטַּמְּעָה Nithpa.) once mixed with Israelites beyond traces of genealogical disabilities, shall remain so (shall not be traced up).
